## Checklist

- [ ] **Base branch is `development`** (external PRs must target `development`, not `main`)
- [ ] Branch name matches `type/username/short-description` (types: `feat`, `fix`, `hotfix`, `chore`, `refactor`)
- [ ] Commits are signed — verify with `git log --show-signature -1`
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Linters pass locally (`ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `yamllint -c .yamllint.yaml .`, `shellcheck`, `bandit -r Automation/ --ini .bandit -f txt`)
- [ ] Relevant policies reviewed (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md#required-reading))
- [ ] If AI-assisted, disclosure is included in the commit body per the [AI/LLM Development Policy](https://github.com/EVR-RDY-Projects/evrrdy-mcp-internal/blob/main/policy/development/ai-llm-development-policy.md)
